id: title:HaynesPostHog:decompress encoded stylesheets in the recording rasterizer

review.posthog_relevance: RequestInterceptor now reads streamed responses, checks stylesheet size, and decodes content-encoding before returning CSS to the browser. This could prevent oversized or unsupported-encoding requests from breaking session replay, and could reduce memory usage by not loading full bodies before checking limits.
review.reason: Adds zlib decompression and streaming support, stylesheet size and encoding-layer limits, and a decoder implementation.
